visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A long-haired woman in a black lace corset dress with sheer floral leggings stands in front of a black promotional wall featuring 'UBJ' and 'TRUEDAN' logos. She holds a black tablet, displaying it to a man wearing a tiger wrestler mask, a black denim jacket over a grey hoodie, and blue jeans. He holds a green disposable cup. The lighting is bright studio style. (2) The scene shifts to a mirrored room where the woman is surrounded by five men in street clothes, including hats and beanies. They lean in to watch the content on her tablet, exhibiting focused facial expressions. (3) The camera cuts back to the tiger-masked man, then back to the group in the mirror room. The woman points at the tablet screen while speaking animatedly. (4) In a bright hallway, the woman in black stands next to another woman with long brown hair wearing a silver, highly-revealing sparkling cutout dress. An 'Inspiration Helmet' poster is visible behind them. They both look at the tablet and gesture with their hands. (5) The woman in black lace interviews a person dressed in elaborate Japanese Geisha attire, featuring a green and gold kimono and a large floral headpiece. They are in a well-lit corridor. (6) A young man with black hair wearing an open-chest black suit jacket stands in a white hallway, reacting to the tablet content with surprised eyes and hand gestures. (7) A man in a bright purple suit with silver shoulder tassels and large rings looks at the tablet, holding his chin in a thinking pose. (8) The video concludes with a series of quick cuts between these various individuals as they continue to provide feedback, culminating in a shot of the woman and the tiger-masked man again.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with high energy and clarity over an upbeat electronic pop BGM. She introduces her new work. (2) A male voice reacts with a sharp exclamation of surprise as the BGM continues with a steady four-on-the-floor beat. (3) There is a subtle 'Ding' sound effect as a logo appears on screen. The female host's voice remains dominant as she asks for feedback. (4) A chorus of multiple male voices chatter and laugh in a mirrored room environment, creating a low-intensity crowd noise floor. (5) A series of quick cuts between different speakers (including the Geisha and the young man) occurs, each with distinct pitch and tonal qualities, ranging from flamboyant to calm, all overlapping with the continuous BGM. (6) A 'Whoosh' transition sound occurs during a fast visual edit. (7) The final phase features a confident male voice giving a numerical score, his tone professional yet impressed, with the BGM swelling slightly before cutting off.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional tool to generate hype for a new music video (MV). By capturing and editing together the enthusiastic reactions of various colorful personalities and influencers, it uses social proof and FOMO (fear of missing out) to encourage viewers to watch the full MV when it drops.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The main character is literally showing a tablet with her new MV to people to get their feedback and promote it.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features high production value in terms of social media editing, with fast cuts and frequent subtitles to maintain viewer engagement. The diverse range of interviewees adds to the 'event' atmosphere.
